line: Bamboo grows slowly for 25 days, then shoots up. Which day are you on?
credit: Moso bamboo study · Zhejiang A&F University, 2013

line: Like the sea, practice gets deeper slowly, step by step, never all at once.
So keep going. A thousand days of practice shape you. Ten thousand polish you.
credit: Miyamoto Musashi · The Book of Five Rings, 1645

line: Be like a star: never in a hurry, never stopping.
Heavy and steady comes first. Light and quick grow out of it.
Now go easy on the whip and hold the reins. Speed comes by itself.
Slow to get the horse ready, but quick to get there.
credit: Russian proverb · Не скоро запряг, да скоро приехал

line: Inside, it works the same: the steadier your focus, the clearer you see.
But the pianist who rushes past the basics never plays anything well.
In Thailand we say: slow gets it done, time makes it good. Start slow.
credit: Thai proverb · ช้าเป็นการ นานเป็นคุณ
